source.changes: SRD 5.2.1 pp. 243–246 adapted into twelve versioned magic-item families (Shield, +1, +2, or +3 through Staff of Striking) with explicit variant identities, structured requirements and typed source values. Names, numeric rules and key phrases are adapted into keys; no rules prose is reproduced. The Spell Scroll also carries its p. 99 adventuring gear listing, with the 30 GP cantrip and 50 GP level 1 prices printed there. No other price is listed; the rest remain unspecified. Catalogue data grants no inventory, action or gameplay permissions; every record is unavailable.
